messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: multi-facetting strip labels mixed up
parts:
Dear list,

Consider this,

d = data.frame(x=rnorm(10), f1 = rep(letters[1:2],each=5), f2 =
rep(LETTERS[1:2],length=10))

library(lattice)
xyplot(x~x | f1*f2, data=d)

dev.new()
library(ggplot2)
qplot(x,x, data=d) + facet_grid(.~f1*f2)

The same data are plotted, but the strip labels make no sense to me in
ggplot2, it looks as though their order is mixed up (
http://i.imgur.com/dPKz4.png ). Is it just me?

Thanks,

baptiste

messages.subject: Re: multi-facetting strip labels mixed up
parts:
Hi Baptiste:

It's not just you; I get the same result on my Win7 64-bit box. According to the facet_grid() help page, the following should work:

ggplot(data = d, aes(x = x, y = x)) + geom_point() + facet_grid(. ~ f1 + f2)

but the same result occurs.

Dennis
